about: REGRESSION set of jarvis/domain/tool_relevance.py (plugins MCP, Slice 04 QA rework; docs/mcp/plugins.md §6.4). NOT a held-out set: its intents paraphrase the misses QA published, so it guards the vocabulary added for them and says nothing about fresh wording (QA 2 measured 5/15 there; known V1 limit, plugins.md §7). Written before the vocabulary change, by a different author persona (a French executive assistant using Microsoft 365) with a different tool vocabulary (Graph-style camelCase names, English API-reference descriptions, no titles). Never tune ranking weights on it: only vocabulary and tokenization changes are allowed, and they must also hold on tests/fixtures/tool_intents.json. Each intent passes when one of `expected` is in the top 3.

external_tools.name: listMessages
external_tools.description: Get the messages in the signed-in user's mailbox (including the Deleted Items and Clutter folders). Supports $search and $filter.

search.description: KQL search string (from:, subject:, body words)

external_tools.name: getMessage
external_tools.description: Retrieve the properties and body of a message object.

external_tools.name: sendMail
external_tools.description: Send the message specified in the request body using JSON format.

external_tools.name: replyToMessage
external_tools.description: Reply to the sender of a message, add a comment or modify any updateable properties all in one reply call. The message is then saved in the Sent Items folder.

external_tools.name: forwardMessage
external_tools.description: Forward a message using a comment. The message is saved in the Sent Items folder.

external_tools.name: createDraftMessage
external_tools.description: Create a draft of a new message in JSON format. The draft can be updated and sent later.

external_tools.name: moveMessage
external_tools.description: Move a message to another folder within the specified user's mailbox. This creates a new copy of the message in the destination folder and removes the original message.

destinationId.description: Destination folder id or well-known name (archive, deleteditems, junkemail)

external_tools.name: listMailFolders
external_tools.description: Get the mail folder collection directly under the root folder of the signed-in user.

external_tools.name: listAttachments
external_tools.description: Retrieve a list of attachment objects attached to a message.

external_tools.name: getAttachment
external_tools.description: Read the properties, relationships, or raw contents of an attachment attached to a message.

external_tools.name: listCalendarView
external_tools.description: Get the occurrences, exceptions, and single instances of events in a calendar view defined by a time range.

external_tools.name: createCalendarEvent
external_tools.description: Create an event in the user's default calendar and send invitations to attendees.

external_tools.name: cancelEvent
external_tools.description: This action allows the organizer of a meeting to send a cancellation message and cancel the event.

external_tools.name: findMeetingTimes
external_tools.description: Suggest meeting times and locations based on organizer and attendee availability, and time or location constraints.

external_tools.name: listContacts
external_tools.description: Get a contact collection from the default contacts folder of the signed-in user.

external_tools.name: getContact
external_tools.description: Retrieve the properties of a contact object: display name, email addresses, businessPhones, mobilePhone, home address.

external_tools.name: searchPeople
external_tools.description: Retrieve a collection of person objects ordered by their relevance to the user.

external_tools.name: searchDriveItems
external_tools.description: Search the hierarchy of items for items matching a query. You can search within a folder hierarchy, a whole drive, or files shared with the current user.

q.description: Query text matched against filename, metadata and file content

external_tools.name: listDriveItemChildren
external_tools.description: Return a collection of DriveItems in the children relationship of a DriveItem.

external_tools.name: downloadDriveItem
external_tools.description: Download the contents of the primary stream (file) of a DriveItem. Only driveItems with the file property can be downloaded.

external_tools.name: uploadDriveItem
external_tools.description: Provide the contents of a new file or update the contents of an existing file in a single API call. Supports files up to 250 MB.

external_tools.name: createFolder
external_tools.description: Create a new folder or DriveItem in a Drive with a specified parent item or path.

external_tools.name: inviteDriveItem
external_tools.description: Sends a sharing invitation for a DriveItem. A sharing invitation provides permissions to the recipients and optionally sends an email to the recipients to notify them the item was shared.

external_tools.name: listTodoTasks
external_tools.description: Get the todoTask resources from the specified task list.

external_tools.name: createTodoTask
external_tools.description: Create a new task object in a specified todoTaskList.

external_tools.name: updateTodoTask
external_tools.description: Update the properties of a todoTask object, for example set its status to completed.

external_tools.name: listChats
external_tools.description: Retrieve the list of chats that the user is part of.

external_tools.name: sendChatMessage
external_tools.description: Send a new chatMessage in the specified chat.
